summary: iter_209 FUUSIC (TIP EARNS POINTS + WHO'S PAID TRACKER + PILL AUTO REVEAL) — 4/5 backend tests GREEN; 1 BACKEND BUG found in /api/scan-to-pay/splits/mine. (A) TIP EARNS POINTS ✅ all 3 cases pass: $5 subtotal + $2 tip at 100% BigPoints → capture.bigcoin_earned=20 (tip-portion only, points_per_dollar=10 * $2); same bill with tip_cents=0 earns 0 BC; same bill at full-card (via quote) earns 70 BC on whole total. The 100% points path never calls Stripe (card_cents=0), confirming no restricted-key charge. (B) WHO'S PAID TRACKER backend — splits/mine returns the seeded split with total_amount_cents=2000, 2 shares (You PAID AED 10/paid_at set, Alex PENDING AED 10), status=partial, and the mobile UI (data-testid='split-card-bsplit_demo_whospaid') renders KC avatar, 'Karak Cafe Dubai (QA Demo)', AED 20.00, PARTIAL badge, '1/2 paid' progress bar (data-testid 'split-bsplit_demo_whospaid-progress'), You PAID / Alex PENDING rows; all 4 filter chips present (All/Pending/Partial/Completed/Expired). NO 'AED 0.00' / 'Merchant' / 'Payer N' placeholders surface because the mobile UI falls back to `description.replace(/^Split at /,'')`. BUT the backend contract advertised in the review request `merchant{business_name,logo_url}` is INCORRECT: splits/mine returns `merchant.business_name=null, logo_url=null, category=null` for biz_demo_karak (the merchant doc actually stores `name` + `category`, not `business_name`+`category_id`). This masks only because the seeded description preserves the merchant name — a user-created split with a different description would show 'Merchant' placeholder. (C) PILL AUTO REVEAL — code is correctly wired at home.tsx:170-176 (onScroll calls revealNewPosts when transitioning to top with pending>0); home scroll does NOT crash; pill is absent at idle load — matches iter_207/208 (fresh followed-feed item cannot be deterministically produced in 25s poll window). (D) Regression: tab-scan-pay FAB present, home-nearby-0-deal visible with text 'Claim 50% off Karak'.

minor.issue: merchant.business_name + merchant.logo_url + merchant.category are null for biz_demo_karak. services/bill_split_service.py:173-188 _merchant_summary() queries fields `business_name`+`category_id` from the businesses collection, but the demo merchant stores `name`+`category`. Review request explicitly guarantees `merchant{business_name,logo_url}` — contract not honored. Mobile UI currently masks this with a `description.replace(/^Split at /,'')` fallback, so the seeded card renders correctly, but any split whose description doesn't start with 'Split at <name>' will display literal 'Merchant' placeholder and no logo.

action_items: Fix services/bill_split_service.py:_merchant_summary — add fallback to `biz.get('business_name') or biz.get('name')` and `biz.get('category_id') or biz.get('category')` so the splits/mine payload honors the advertised contract. Also project `name` + `category` in the find_one projection (lines 174-179). Non-blocking for the seeded demo (UI fallback paints over it) but a latent bug for any real/user-created split.
critical_code_review_comments: services/bill_split_service.py:173-188 — _merchant_summary projects only {business_id, business_name, category_id, logo_url, currency}. Demo merchant biz_demo_karak and most seeded businesses store `name` + `category`. Should defensively coalesce both (`business_name or name`, `category_id or category`). Low-risk 4-line patch.

services/scan_to_pay_service.py:222-229 — _compute_quote earn rule is correctly updated: `points_earned = int(subtotal_card_cents/100 * ppd) + int(tip_cents/100 * ppd)`. Points are applied to subtotal first (points_on_subtotal = min(points_value_cents, subtotal)), so a 100%-points bill with tip earns ONLY on tip. Verified end-to-end via capture.bigcoin_earned.

mobile/app/my-splits.tsx:95 — `const merchantName = sp.merchant?.business_name || (sp.description || '').replace(/^Split at /, '') || 'Merchant';` — graceful 3-tier fallback. This is why the seeded card renders 'Karak Cafe Dubai (QA Demo)' despite the backend bug. OK as defensive UI, but the backend should still ship the field.

mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:170-176 — onHomeScroll correctly uses atTopRef sentinel so revealNewPosts only fires on a down→up transition (not on every top-tick). y<=8 threshold is reasonable. Non-crashing when pendingFeed empty (early-return at 159). Trigger cannot be reproduced in-harness (requires a fresh followed-user feed item within 25s poll) — code path is correct by inspection.

Non-blocking console noise: 'shadow* deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated', 'Require cycle app/(tabs)/social.tsx → src/social/wall.tsx', 'expo-notifications web unsupported'. All pre-existing (also noted in iter_207/208). Not newly introduced.
